message: Last summer, as the weather folks started buzzing about a potential hurricane, I found myself rummaging through my pantry. Turns out, I had a stash of canned soups and a couple of boxes of crackers I’d forgotten about. I felt like a champion! A small win that saved the day, because when the winds picked up, we had enough comfort food to keep spirits high. It’s those little moments that remind me preparedness can be as simple as checking what’s in the cupboard. What’s hiding in your pantry? 🥫
